sourceTitle: How a field job moves from request to finished visit
observedAudience: Owners and office staff who schedule, dispatch and record field jobs. No developer knowledge is needed.
observedLearningOutcomes: Explain the difference between a job, a visit and a worker in the app.
Describe the order in which a customer request becomes a completed visit.
Identify which record holds each part of a customer request.
